description: Go source structure limits for agents and hooks. Prevents spaghetti growth while grandfathering known debt.

commentBlockLines._comment: Empirically calibrated against the real tree (17.8k blocks, p90=6, p99=14, max=83) - not the rule-30 prose target. Soft is informational only, never strict-promoted, since dense WHY comments up to ~25 lines are established, audited-as-legitimate style here. Hard blocks genuine essays; the 10 files already past it are grandfathered below via baseline (growth-only, same pattern as fileLines.baseline).

baseline.comment: Files already over hard limits. Growth beyond maxLines fails. Reduce maxLines when splitting; never raise without review.

internal/cli/chat_slash.go.note: extracted slash dispatch; split command groups
